name: 2022-1c-recuperatorio-parcial2
title: CustomerImporter: The Return (Sales Import)
description: Starting from the existing CSV customer importer, the student must add, with TDD, an importer for a sales CSV made of multi-line records (S sale header, EC existing customer or NC new customer, one or more P products, ES end of sale), robust to format errors, where a sale is only created when it is valid (one buyer, at least one product), storing sales in the same transient system.

design.notes: A sale spans several CSV lines, so the importer is a small parser state machine (outside a sale / inside a sale collecting a buyer and products until ES) that should end in a Builder creating a complete valid Sale; the hints push toward extracting a generic CSVImporter superclass (Insert Superclass, Push Up) and reusing the customer-record import for NC records.
